messages.content: Kofi! Long time man. You still doing car stereos on the side, or is it strictly the old hi-fi now?
Darnell! Strictly home audio. Haven't had my head under a dash since I left the dealership. What's going on?
My nephew's 2011 F-150. Radio went totally dead, no clock, no display, nothing. Shop wants $900 to swap the whole head unit
You were always the one who chased the wire before throwing parts at it, so I figured I'd ask you first
Dead with no clock usually means no power is getting to it. Have him check the radio fuse and the ground behind the dash before anybody spends $900.
Fuse panel is behind the trim in the passenger footwell. Tell him to pull the negative battery cable before he unplugs anything back there.
Bet. He's off Saturday, I'll make him do it 👊🏾
Update: fuse was fine, it was the ground. Strap behind the dash was loose and green with corrosion. He cleaned it up and the radio came right back on. Shop can keep that $900 😂
Glad it was the cheap fix. A dab of dielectric grease on that connection will keep the green from coming back.
Passing that along. He says he owes you a Buddy's pizza
Luis is collecting $20 a head for Big Mike's retirement gift. I'll cover yours and you can square up with me at the lunch
Appreciate it. Cash at the lunch, no dealership markup.
finally caved and bought a Hakko for my makerspace bench. want my old Weller station before it goes on eBay?
The tan Magnastat? Maybe. What tips come with it?
that one. two chisels and a fine conical, plus the stand and sponge. $30 and it's yours
Deal. A second iron with a fat chisel saves me swapping tips every time I hit a ground lug.
sold. I'll hang onto it till I see you, it's not going anywhere
you around for coffee this week? I can bring the Weller, and there's something I want to pick your brain on
Friday at 8:30, Astro? I need to be back on my bench by 10.
perfect. it's about repair night at the space. we keep getting old receivers and nobody knows where to start
Sounds familiar. Bring a list of what's been coming in and we'll sort it out over coffee.
will do. see you friday
good catching up friday. the space said yes, you're on for repair night Thu July 9 at 6:30. putting 'vintage audio with Kofi' on the flyer
I'll be there with a variac and a box of fuses. Your old Weller is already earning its keep, by the way.
Kofi, UPS left one of your boxes on my porch this afternoon. Heavy one, marked FRAGILE on two sides.
I didn't want it sitting out in the heat, so it's just inside my front door.
Sorry about that, Lorraine, and thank you for bringing it in. Walking over now.
I'm on the porch. Tell Kwame I'm still admiring his chalk robot on my sidewalk.
Lorraine, is my garage floodlight shining into your back windows? I've been leaving it on overnight since that car door business.
Not one bit. My blinds are thick, and I'd rather have the light.
Malik says nobody's been back since, so leave it on.
Saw your message about the speakers. Would you run the music for the whole party? Last year we had one little Bluetooth speaker nobody could hear past my steps.
Happy to. I'll need power out by the street. Okay if I run a cord from your porch outlet?
The outlet is yours. I'll set out a card table by the steps for your equipment.
Meant to tell you, I set my UPS account earlier to leave everything at my side door by the garage. Hopefully that's the last box you have to haul inside.
We'll see what that driver does with it. Thank you, Kofi.
Chale, happy Father's Day! You saw the Black Stars? Whole street here watched on one TV running off a generator 😂
Thank you! Watched every minute. Efua says I shouted at the TV louder than Kwame did.
😂 as you should
Wish I'd been on that street with you. Our watch party was three people on one couch.
I'm back in Detroit Friday. Rest of the tournament we watch together
And tell Kwame I found him a real Black Stars World Cup jersey. Not the fake ones from the roadside
He's going to lose his mind. Safe travels, text me when you land.
Landed! Jersey survived the trip, and there's a jar of shito in my bag with your name on it
Welcome back! Kwame has asked about that jersey every day this week. Come by tomorrow after 2? I'll be back from an estate sale by then.
After 2 works. If I fall asleep on your couch, just leave me there
Just got back from camping at Sleeping Bear. Kwame wore that jersey the whole weekend, sand and all. Efua says thank you. The shito is already half gone and she's blaming me.
😂 Best review I could ask for. Welcome home, rest up
Hi Tony, this is Kofi Mensah on Prairie St. Lorraine Pettiford gave me your number. I'm looking for a quote on a dedicated 20 amp circuit for my garage.
Lorraine's good people. I can swing by Monday around 4 and take a look at your panel.
Monday works. Could you make it 4:15? I do school pickup at 3:15. It's 17241 Prairie, garage is out back.
4:15 is fine. I'll look at the main panel first, then walk out to the garage.
Thanks for having me out. Dedicated 20 amp run to the garage comes to $640, permit included.
That's a new breaker, 12 gauge out to the garage and two GFCI outlets on the bench wall. Your panel has room, so no upgrade needed.
Thanks Tony. Let me look at the numbers and I'll get back to you by the end of the month.
Sounds good. Price holds 30 days.
One question while I think it over. Should the bench lights move to the new circuit, or stay where they are?
Leave the lights where they are. If a heat gun or an amp on test trips the 20, you're not standing in the dark holding a hot iron.
That's happened to me twice already. Lights stay put.

Tony, sorry I'm a couple days past the end of the month. I'm going to hold off until fall, since summer is when most of my money goes into estate-sale stock. I'll text you in September for a fresh number. Thanks for coming out.
Massa! Sunday ball at Palmer Park is back. 4pm, same field. You coming or you've retired? 😂
Not retired, just tired. Block party was yesterday and I was hauling speakers till late. Next Sunday, save me the gloves.
Just off shift. Sunday we had nine guys and nobody wanted goal. Lost 7-3 😂 This week no excuse oo
7-3 is painful. I'm in for Sunday. Just know I don't dive anymore, my hip filed a complaint.
Up early eh! Bring Kwame one of these Sundays, the small ones kick around behind the goal. He's what, 6 now?
6, and first grade starts in a couple weeks. He's up at 6:30 every day, summer or not. He'd love it.
Good game today. Not many Sundays left before the cold comes. Bring Kwame next week, my nephews will be there too.
Sorry for the slow reply, long week. Just got out of curriculum night at his school. We're both in for Sunday. My auntie gave him a new ball and he won't put it down.
Perfect. Tell him to bring water and shin guards if he has them. The kids go hard by the fence 😂
Also my speaker died, the orange one. It charges but no sound. Can you look at it?
Bring it Sunday. Charges but no sound is usually the amp board or a loose ribbon cable. My fee is one plate of kelewele.
Field is dry, we're on for 4. Speaker is in my trunk and the kelewele is handled. Tell Kwame to bring the new ball 💪🏾
Block club cleanup is Saturday May 16, 9 to noon. Bags and gloves will be on my porch.
I'll bring the leaf blower and the big rake.
Heads up, somebody was pulling car door handles on our block around 3am. Lock up later.
Thank you Malik. I'll call our neighborhood police officer this morning.
Thanks for the heads up. I'll leave the floodlight over the garage on overnight.
Fireworks went till 2am. Anybody else's dog still hiding under the bed?
Block party is Saturday August 8, 3 to 8. Bring a dish and a chair, street closes at 2.
We're in. Efua's making jollof and I'll bring a pair of speakers for the music.
Great party everybody. Kofi, those speakers had the whole block doing the electric slide
Thank you Lorraine for pulling it together again ❤️
Anybody have a snow guy lined up for this winter? Mine finally retired.
My grandson Trey does driveways, $25 a pass. I'll send you his number.
Trick-or-treat on Prairie is Saturday 6 to 8. Porch lights on if you're handing out candy 🎃
We'll be out with Kwame from 6, bowl on the porch. Look for the robot with blinking lights.
Kwame about to win Halloween 😂
Hi 1st grade families! I'm room parent this year, so class updates and volunteer asks will go here 🍎
Thank you for organizing, Tasha. Happy to help with anything science related.
Found a blue water bottle with a dinosaur sticker in Kwame's backpack. Anyone missing one?
That's Jayden's!! He's been mourning it all week 😭 thank you
Sending it back with Kwame tomorrow.
Class Halloween party is Friday right after the parade. Snack and supply sign up sheet went home in folders 🎃
We'll send napkins and cups with Kwame on Thursday.
Juice boxes from us 🧃
Cider mill field trip is Thursday 10/15. We still need 3 chaperones, reply here if you can come.
I can do it, I'm off Thursdays
Count me in too!
Big Mike's last day is June 12. Retirement lunch at noon, place TBD. Who's in?
I'm in. 31 years in that building, man deserves a parade
in
Count me in. Still owe Mike for every wiring diagram he ever bailed me out with.
Good turnout today. Mike teared up twice, don't tell him I said that
😂 he'll deny it till the day he dies
Fantasy draft is Sunday at 9. Need two more teams, $20 buy in. Who's in?
In. And I'm not finishing last again
League rule change. Last place buys wings for the whole league once the season's over.
Dealership's doing a trunk or treat in the service lot this year, day TBD. Alumni welcome. Who's bringing kids?

Do I need a photo ID tomorrow, or is my voter registration card enough?

You'll be asked for a photo ID, like a Michigan driver's license or state ID card. Your voter registration card isn't required. If you don't have ID with you, you can sign an affidavit and vote a regular ballot.

Thank you so much for today, Auntie. The tilapia was perfect, and Kwame has not put his new football down once. 🙏🏾
Your new goalkeeper.
All of us in one picture, finally!

My dear Efua, thank you for coming, and for the jollof. Not one grain is left. Kwame is getting so big, he will be the tallest in first grade. I will print the one of all of us for my living room. Did you reach home safe? God bless. Auntie Abena 🙏
Yes, home safe. Kofi is changing for his bike ride, and Kwame is practicing his saves in the hallway.
Always that bicycle! Tell Kofi the kelewele in the blue container is for HIM, not for sharing. And you must write down that jollof for me, mine never comes out like yours. 🙏
The kelewele went straight to the back of the fridge, Auntie. That is my reward after the ride, and Efua and Kwame have been warned.
It's all in frying the tomato paste longer than feels right. I'll write it out for you this week. Thank you again for having us, Auntie. 🙏🏾

Auntie, here is the jollof recipe. Once the paste is dark red, add the blended tomatoes and peppers and cook until the oil rises. Then add the stock, thyme, curry powder and a bay leaf, and stir in the washed rice. Put foil under the lid, keep the heat very low, and do not stir for 30 minutes.
Thank you my dear, I have copied it into my recipe book. Foil under the lid, nobody EVER told me that! I will make it for the ladies at church and see if they notice the difference. 🙏

My dear Kofi, Kwame told me after church that he is going to be a ROBOT for Halloween and that his daddy is putting lights in it. Please make sure those wires do not get HOT against his chest. When I was nursing I saw burns from less. God bless. Auntie Abena 🙏
